[[Lowhhrick/Legends|Lowhhrick's]] '''nephew''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] who lived on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] before being killed by [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] raiding parties, who had traveled from the nearby planet [[Trandosha/Legends|Trandosha]] to hunt Wookiees for sport.<ref name="EotEBG" />
